name: Peri Peri Potato Chips
ingredients_raw: Potato (60%), edible vegetable oil (palmolein), mixed spice (peri peri chilli pepper, black pepper, maltodextrin, sugar, salt, cumin powder, mustard seeds, onion powder, dried oregano, ginger powder, cardamom powder, acidity regulator: E296, flavour enhancers: (E627, E631), anticaking agent: E170(i)). Contain added permitted natural colour: paprika oleoresin (INS 160c). Contain added flavour: natural and nature-identical flavouring substance.
